The Double Name Revival

Double names (also called double-barreled or hyphenated names) combine two given names into a single identity. They peaked in the American South but are now trending nationwide. In 2026, searches for "double names that start with Mary" became the hottest name-related query.

Why Choose a Double Name?

  • • Honors two family members at once
  • • Sounds elegant and distinctive
  • • Provides multiple nickname options
  • • Balances tradition with creativity

Popular Combinations

  • • Mary-Anne, Mary-Kate, Mary-Jane
  • • Anna-Marie, Emma-Rose
  • • Lily-May, Rose-Marie
  • • Sarah-Jane, Kate-Lynn
